senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; צוּד)hunting apparatus, net, trap; bow.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:6">Ib. XV, 6</cite> <he>מְצוּדַת החולדה</he> a trap for weasels.
<cite ref="Shabbat 43b:3">Sabb. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא יעשנה כמ׳</he> he must not spread the mat so as to form a trap (for the bees).

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:6">Esth. R. to III, 2</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 140:6">Ps. CXL, 6</cite>) <he>מ׳ פרשו לי או״ה וכ׳</he> the nations laid a trap to ruin me, saying to me, worship idols &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:16">Ab. III, 16</cite> <he>מ׳ פרוסה על וכ׳</he> a net is spread over all the living (none can escape divine judgment); a. e.—

Ber. 9ᵇ; Pes. 119ᵃ כמ׳ זו שאין בה דגים Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) like a net without fish; (oth. vers. כמ׳ … דגן like a fort without provision; Rashi: like a trap without grain to attract the birds), v. מְצוּלָה.—Pl. מְצוּדוֹת.

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:1">Tosef. Bets. III, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 13:5:1">Y. Sabb. XIII, 14ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 3:2:2">Y. Bets. III, 62ᵃ</cite> top <cite ref="M02267"><he>מְצָדוֹת</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 4:2:2">Y. Erub. IV, 21ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מצודות</he>, read: <cite ref="M02293"><he>מְצוֹפוֹת</he></cite>.]
